title: Rabbi Naftali Besser: Staying Inspired- "Parashat Vayera"

chapters.title: Review of Lech Lecha and Background
Avraham's Wealth and Journey Back to Canaan

summary: Rabbi Besser discusses lessons from Parashat Vayera, focusing on Avraham Avinu, the concept of Derech Eretz, and how the Torah teaches sensitivity to others. He shares stories and insights related to these themes.
questions: What does Parashat Vayera teach us about etiquette and Derech Eretz?
Why does the Torah mention Avraham returning through the same inns he used previously?
How do our matriarchs and patriarchs teach us sensitivity towards others?
